_description: How fyp-pillow is consumed. pest-detection-processor is the only consumer; it depends on Pillow (PIL) for image/bbox drawing.
layer_source_zip_location: NOT_IN_S3 (lambda-layers-366356442579 bucket contains only ffmpeg-layer.zip; fyp-pillow was published directly from local build)
pillow_provides: Pillow 12.2.0, cp312, manylinux2014_x86_64 (matches python3.12 Lambda runtime, x86_64 arch). Layer zip structure is python/PIL/... including the compiled _imaging*.so C-extension and the pillow.libs directory.
v1_failure_lesson: fyp-pillow:1 was broken: it was missing the compiled _imaging*.so C-extension, so import PIL succeeded at build but failed at runtime and no bbox was ever drawn. Fix was rebuilding correctly with the C-extension + pillow.libs and republishing as fyp-pillow:2. deploy.py MUST verify _imaging*.so and pillow.libs are present in the zip before publishing.
version_source: Recorded in local repo docs (docs/history/HANDOFF_W8_Thursday.md, _archive Interim_Report_Qian_Runzhe_v3). AWS metadata does not store the pip version; only the description 'Self-built Pillow for pest-detection-processor' on v1.
recreate_note: deploy.py must build fyp-pillow from scratch and pin Pillow==12.2.0 for cp312 / manylinux2014_x86_64 (see deploy_notes).
